description: Once the buyer approves a dealership's verified Out-The-Door quote, unlock the buyer's real name, email/phone, and preferred appointment window to the dealership. Requires explicit buyer permission (consent=true).

buyer_email.description: Buyer's real email address (at least one of buyer_email or buyer_phone is required).

buyer_phone.description: Buyer's real phone number (at least one of buyer_email or buyer_phone is required).

consent.description: Explicit buyer consent flag. Must be true to unlock buyer PII to the dealership.

notes.description: Optional final instructions for the sales manager.

opt_in_classic_ppi_shipping.description: Optional collector opt-in: include a 150-point classic pre-purchase lift inspection (PPI) and enclosed hard-side carrier dispatch handoff.

opt_in_insurance_quote.description: Optional buyer opt-in: return a VIN-prefilled insurance comparison payload alongside the locked OTD deal.

preferred_appointment_window.description: Preferred appointment or delivery window (e.g., 'Saturday 11:00 AM - 1:00 PM').

thread_id.description: The proxy deal thread_id being accepted.

name: accept_deal_and_reveal
title: Accept Verified OTD Deal & Reveal Buyer Identity (Consent-Gated)
